pkg_tools.py.summary: Package-management toolkit for apt, pip and wheels.
details: Subcommands: ``apt-install``/``apt-reinstall`` install the apt packages by wildcard or from a list, ``wheel-install``/``wheel-install-local`` install the local ``.whl`` files (optionally deleting them), ``wheel-move-installed`` sorts the wheels of the installed distributions and ``pip-uninstall``/``pip-uninstall-flake8`` fuzzy-uninstall the packages by prefix.

pkgfetch.py.summary: Download the distributions matching a requirement from the PEP 503/691 indexes.
details: Queries PyPI (with the Tsinghua and Yandex mirrors as fallbacks), matches the Python version and the platform tags, picks the best wheel or sdist, verifies the hash and the archive integrity and downloads through httpx (with parallel ranges), aria2c, requests or pycurl.

pkgres.py.summary: Detect and replace the deprecated ``pkg_resources`` usage.
details: Rewrites the common calls (``get_distribution`` version/entry points, ``resource_filename``, ``require`` ...) to ``importlib.metadata``/``importlib.resources``, reports the generic leftovers, and with ``-a`` applies the rewrite in a pool.

pkgtools.py.summary: Copy, move and repack the installed Python packages.
details: Subcommands: ``record`` copies or moves the files listed in a ``RECORD`` from the current dist-info, ``site-copy`` copies the installed package directories out of ``site-packages``, ``repack`` rebuilds them into a wheel-like directory layout and ``entry-points`` lists the packages declaring console scripts.

Subcommands: ``check-system-bin`` compares the files with ``/system/bin``, ``missing-files`` audits the installed dpkg packages for missing files, ``copy-pkg-files`` copies the files of one package, ``orphan-libs-debian``/``orphan-pkgs-termux`` find the unused packages, ``list-installed-sizes`` ranks the packages by installed size and ``make-deb`` builds a ``.deb``.

pkl_tool.py.summary: Convert, inspect or dump pickle files.
details: The ``to-json`` subcommand serialises the payload (bytes as base64, the non-JSON types as strings), ``inspect`` describes the structure and the types with a ``--max-repr`` preview and ``to-raw`` writes a bytes payload verbatim.
pkl_tool.py.notes: Unpickling executes code; only open files you trust.

pnr.py.summary: Rename the files and directories by removing, replacing or templating their names.
details: ``-r STRING`` removes a substring, ``-s OLD NEW`` replaces one and ``-t TEMPLATE`` renames with sequential numbering; ``--recursive`` descends the tree and ``--dry-run`` previews.

pnr2.py.summary: Advanced file renamer with regex, filters and an undo log.
details: Extends :doc:`pnr` with ``--regex``, case-insensitive matching, include/exclude globs, extension, file/dir and hidden filters, a depth limit and a JSON log of the performed renames.

psearch.py.summary: Search the PyPI packages by name or keyword.
details: Queries the PyPI search endpoint, prints the matching name, version and summary (or JSON with ``-j``), honouring the result limit and the timeout.

pss.py.summary: Search a local PyPI package database by substring.
details: Uses the SQLite FTS5 trigram index at ``/sdcard/data/pip.db`` to find the package names containing the keyword and prints the best ``-n`` matches.

Subcommands: ``detect`` classifies the sources as Py2 or Py3, ``refactor`` applies the lib2to3 fixers (dry run by default, ``-a`` writes), ``fixprint`` rewrites the ``print x`` and ``except X, e:`` lines, ``run2to3`` shells out to the external ``2to3`` and ``strip-tag`` removes the ``Tag:py2-none-any`` lines from the WHEEL members of the archives.

py_clean.py.summary: Strip the comments, docstrings and type hints of Python files with LibCST.
details: ``-c`` removes the comment blocks, ``-d`` the docstrings, ``-t`` the annotations plus the unused typing imports and ``-a`` everything; an ``.ignore`` file filters the tree, the writes can be previewed with ``--dry-run``/``--diff`` and backed up, and every pool method is supported.

pybat.py.summary: A Python port of ``bat``: cat with syntax highlighting.
details: Same feature set as :doc:`pbat` (Pygments highlighting, line numbers, git markers, themes, line ranges and paging) with the streaming reader used here.

pycatimg.py.summary: Display images in the terminal with true colour.
details: Resizes the image (SVG rendered through CairoSVG at ``--dpi``) to the terminal or the requested width/height, draws it with the 24-bit ANSI colours and the half-block characters (``--no-half-blocks`` for the plain mode) and fills the transparent areas with ``--bg-color``.

pyclean.py.summary: Python source cleaner: docstrings and comments.
details: Subcommands: ``strip`` removes the docstrings and/or the comments with the ast, LibCST or text engine (``--engine``), ``check`` reports what a file still contains and ``clean-module-doc`` drops the generated ``Module for X.`` docstring; ``--tidy`` also collapses the blank lines.

pydeduper.py.summary: Consolidate the duplicate top-level definitions of a tree into ``utils/``.
details: Extracts the functions, classes and constants with ast (archives and compressed files included), groups the identical ones and the ``report``/``copy``/``move`` subcommands show the groups, copy one representative into ``utils/`` or patch the originals with the imports.
